groups.saying_opens: الصمد السيد المطاع الذي ليس فوقه

notes: Three sayings are stored, each with the same outer chain from the compiler down to the Sadiq; in saying 1 «الباقر» transmits from his father Zayn al-Abidin and Husayn, so he is a narrator there; in saying 2 he relays Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyya (narrator); in saying 3 he speaks his own saying, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«وقال غيره» (an unnamed speaker) and the later sayings («قال: وسئل علي بن الحسين» and Wahb b. Wahb's own isnads) are not stored here: deferred, and their routes need their own reading
The editor's glosses and the «عليهم السلام» blessings are not part of any surface; «أبو الحسن» names are copied with the typos of the source («عليبن», «بن بن»)
